hedge_params.phi_to_finding: TO penalty STRUCTURALLY INEFFECTIVE — sweep phi in {0,1,3,10,30,100,300,1000,3000,10000} reduces one-way TO from 887% only to 720% at phi=10000 with LFC reduction degrading from 53% to 45%. 600% one-way cap UNREACHABLE under STR_1715 alpha basket churn (~750%/yr from membership rotation alone).
hedge_params.objective_function: max alpha'w - (gamma/2) ||B_t' w||^2 - (eps/2) ||w||^2 subject to sum(w)=1, 0<=w<=0.20, max_names<=20
